summary.headline: IndiQube Q2 FY27 revenue rose 34% YoY to INR475 crore and PAT grew 63% to INR57 crore, with VAS at 17% of operating revenue.
summary.overview: Management reported Q2 FY27 revenue of about INR475 crore (up 34% YoY), IGAAP EBITDA of INR105 crore (up 40%) and PAT of INR57 crore (up 63%). H1 revenue was INR904 crore (up 35%) and H1 PAT INR92 crore (up 66%). Steady-state occupancy improved to 91% from 89%, and VAS revenue reached INR154 crore in H1 (up 74%). Management guided to FY27 EBITDA margin of 19-21% (INR380-400 crore) and about 2 million sq ft of rent-paying area additions this year, while introducing new initiatives: a co-investment land pilot (SaiEdge, about INR35 crore), solar expansion, and a retail bank-branch fit-out business.

segments.name: Grow (core managed workspace)
segments.commentary: Core platform of 138 centers in 17 cities, about 10.86 million sq ft and about 241,000 seats across 884 clients; rent-paying area 8.2 million sq ft at Q2 FY27. Clients in GCCs contribute 54% of revenue.

segments.name: Value-added services (IndiQare, DesignQube, MiQube)
segments.commentary: H1 VAS revenue INR154 crore, up 74% YoY, about 17% of operating revenue. Management says VAS margin improved to about 20% from 15% and expects a range of about 18-20% going forward.

segments.name: Solar / IndiQube Eco
segments.commentary: About 30 MW operational capacity with another 30 MW expected within a year; about INR15 crore revenue in H1 against about INR46 crore invested. Payback about 3 years; planned about INR100 crore capex per year in Karnataka, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu.

segments.name: Retail branch management (IndiQare)
segments.commentary: Early pilot with a large gold bank for about 30 branches; banks cited as 500-1,000 branch rollouts a year. Management described it as early, with capex models of INR1,400-1,800 per sq ft.

segments.name: Land co-investment pilot (SaiEdge Realty)
segments.commentary: Proposed investment of about INR35 crore in a Bangalore asset co-owned with investors, to be leased then sold or forward sold. Management said it is a three-year pilot and not core business.

guidance_outlook: FY27 EBITDA margin guided at 19-21% (management also referred to about 22% upper end), implying about INR380-400 crore EBITDA for the full year.
About 2 million sq ft of rent-paying area to be added in FY27, to about 9.7 million sq ft by end FY27; similar addition (about 2 million sq ft, about 44,000 seats) expected in FY28.

Existing headroom of 3.8 million sq ft (about 85,000 seats), of which 2.67 million sq ft is under LOI and 1.14 million sq ft is available in operational buildings; LOI space expected operational in 12-18 months.
EBIT margin expected to range 12-14% (14% at best), with quarterly variation based on area additions.
VAS share of revenue expected to grow by at least 2-4 percentage points on a yearly basis; VAS margin range about 18-20%.
Steady-state occupancy target of 85-90%; corporate occupancy range of 80-85%.
capex_capacity: Solar: about 30 MW under expansion at about INR100 crore capex; similar capex planned next year; about 30 MW operational today.
Land pilot: about INR35 crore (also referred to as INR30 crore) investment in a Bangalore co-ownership asset, located in a micro market with about 800,000 sq ft already at 97% occupancy.
Fit-out investment about INR1,650 per sq ft for new centers; average renewal renovation spend about INR40-50 per sq ft, expensed as opex.
A new Koramangala ownership-model project is at land stage, about 3 years away per management.
Rent-paying area grew from 6.7 million sq ft in Q2 FY26 to 8.2 million sq ft in Q2 FY27.
demand_pricing: Average customer lock-in about 35-38 months; average client tenure about 42 months, and about 47 months for clients above 300 seats, which occupy 65% of occupied space.

Renewals: about 10% annual attrition (about 7 lakh sq ft on 7 million sq ft). About 90% of expiring clients renew; of renewals, about 80% renew on same terms with 6% escalation, about 10% get lower escalation (2-3%) and about 10% get discounts. Renewal rent growth averages about 5% YoY.
41% of revenue from clients occupying more than one IndiQube center; about 63% of clients acquired via own brand and direct channels; brokerage 2.29% of operating revenue.
Management said occupancy dip (87% to 86%) is range-bound; new centers take 5-6 months to break even and 9-12 months to reach about 90% occupancy.
Management said the implied sq ft-to-seat conversion is about 45 sq ft per seat.

qa_highlights.question: Rationale for the proposed ~INR35 crore SaiEdge Realty investment and planned solar capex.
qa_highlights.answer: Pilot co-ownership model to secure supply in micro markets where occupancy is above 90%; IndiQube would lease and then sell or forward-sell, with capital appreciation. Solar capex about INR100 crore per year over the next two years across Karnataka, Maharashtra and Tamil Nadu.

qa_highlights.question: Drivers of the Q2 margin uptick and whether the 20% VAS margin is a floor.
qa_highlights.answer: Management attributed the uptick to occupancy gain (89% to 91%, about 40% of growth), finance cost reduction of 1% (about 25%), VAS margin improvement and operating leverage from a 1% reduction in salary and other costs. VAS margin was not set as a floor; it is expected at about 18-20% as VAS is used as a foot-in-the-door.

qa_highlights.question: Area and seat additions for FY27 and FY28.
qa_highlights.answer: About 2 million sq ft rent-paying area per year (about 44,000 seats), with 85,000 seats of headroom operational over 12-15 months; similar addition expected in FY28.

qa_highlights.question: Renewal rates and renewal economics.
qa_highlights.answer: About 90% of expiring contracts renew; about 80% at same terms with 6% escalation. Renewal spend of INR40-50 per sq ft is expensed and tied to new lock-ins, and EBITDA converts to PBT after capex recovery.

qa_highlights.question: Branch management business and management bandwidth.
qa_highlights.answer: Early pilot with a large gold bank (about 30 branches); about 80% of retail fit-out needs match office interiors. Management said 50% of bandwidth goes to the existing Grow expansion and 50% to new opportunities.

qa_highlights.question: Outlook on AI and flex office demand.
qa_highlights.answer: Management cited 66 million sq ft of 9-month real estate absorption, up 10-11% YoY, and said demand from GCCs and white-collar job growth (about 1 million jobs a year) supports absorption of 60-80 million sq ft.

risks_watch: Occupancy: quarterly dips (86-87%) and ramp-up of about 2 million sq ft in H2 could pressure margins; EBITDA guided to range-bound 19-21%.
Land co-investment pilot (about INR35 crore) and solar capex (about INR100 crore per year) add capital deployment outside core Grow; returns and exit timing are not yet disclosed.
VAS margin may fall toward 18-20% as VAS is used to win clients; management stated margin is not a priority.
Management did not give full VAS P&L breakdown; disclosure of individual services is expected in future quarters.
Rent-paying area vs seat count reconciliation was confusing on the call (area divided by 45 sq ft per seat); clarity on KPIs needed.
AI-driven change in office demand was raised as an open risk; management was positive on absorption.
summary.management_tone: Confident and upbeat on growth and renewal economics, with a clear emphasis on range-bound margins and occupancy. Management was evasive on VAS margin floor, the individual P&L of VAS and solar economics, and deflected some KPI questions to the presentation.
key_quotes: We have delivered another strong quarter, as you would have seen with our earnings presentation.
Our ambition is not simply to build more workspaces. It is to build India's most trusted, integrated and profitable enterprise workspace platform.
So, we are seeing green as a very, very big opportunity to have a foot in the door and start working with a new set of enterprises.
